test_cases.user_prompt: Show me suitable Kolbo image models for a polished ecommerce hero image.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns current image models with identifiers, relevant strengths, capabilities, and credit information.

test_cases.description: Generate a new image in Kolbo.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a cinematic 16:9 campaign image of a glass perfume bottle on black stone with soft violet light.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the requested image, reports the selected model and credit use, and returns the resulting media and session details.

test_cases.description: Browse the authenticated user’s media library.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my most recent Kolbo videos.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the user’s recent video items with useful metadata and media previews without modifying the library.

test_cases.user_prompt: Create a Kolbo AI Doc titled Launch Shot List with a concise six-shot product-video plan.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the complete editable document in the user’s Kolbo workspace and returns its identifier and access details.

test_cases.user_prompt: Find vertical stock footage of neon city streets at night for social video b-roll.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant normalized stock results with source, preview, licensing, attribution, and available variants.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger Kolbo for unrelated calendar requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Kolbo should not be invoked because calendar management is outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger Kolbo for ordinary factual questions that need no creative workflow.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the capital of Portugal?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Kolbo should not be invoked because the question can be answered directly without Kolbo data or media tools.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger a destructive action from an ambiguous request.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The assistant should clarify scope and intent instead of invoking a delete or permanent-delete tool.
